title: What Happens If You Swallow Gum
hook: Stop believing that swallowed gum stays inside you for years.

script.narration: Stop believing that swallowed gum stays inside you for years.

Your stomach acid cannot break down gum base, but your digestive system is not traps. Powerful muscles simply push the gum through your tract just like any other indigestible fiber. It usually exits your body completely within a few days. Have you ever swallowed a piece? Comment yes or no.

description:
Find out what really happens to your body when you accidentally swallow chewing gum. We debunk the old myth with hard biological facts in under a minute.
